explication: ModelOpt is a model-optimization library: users provide Hugging Face, PyTorch, or ONNX models, apply optimization techniques, and export checkpoints for inference deployment. The graph separates PyTorch and ONNX workflows, includes the README’s pruning, NAS, distillation, sparsity, and speculative-decoding capabilities, and shows deployment as a downstream stage. Paths identify relevant source areas from the tree; beyond the sampled files, capability placement follows the README and module structure, so uncertain internal call links are omitted.
